mapper.select: SELECT id,buyer_id,vendor_id,status FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM t_call_records WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_call_records SET status='missed',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE order_id=#{order} AND status='ringing' AND created_at < NOW(3)-INTERVAL 60 SECOND
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_call_records WHERE order_id=#{order} AND status='ringing'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_call_records SET status='accepted',started_at=NOW(3),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ringing'
UPDATE t_call_records SET status=#{status},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ringing'
UPDATE t_call_records SET status='ended',ended_at=NOW(3),duration_sec=#{duration},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('ringing','accepted')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_messages(id,order_id,sender_id,content,system_flag,image_urls) VALUES(#{id},#{order},#{sender},CONCAT('平台网络通话结束，时长 ',FLOOR(#{duration}/60),' 分 ',MOD(#{duration},60),' 秒；录音状态由供应商回调确认'),1,JSON_ARRAY())
